title: Awful Bliss Auto
concept: A solitary figure wanders through decaying structures, witnessing the physical erosion of memory and time.
style: A recurring figure appears throughout: A person in their late thirties wearing a heavy, oversized wool coat in slate gray..

scenes.still_prompt: A vast, derelict conservatory with shattered glass panes and oxidized copper frames.
beats: Wide shot: The figure stands motionless in the center of the cracked marble floor.
Medium shot: The figure brushes a layer of thick dust off a stone pedestal.
Close-up: The figure stares at a single dried leaf caught in a floor crack.
Medium shot: The figure walks slowly toward a rusted iron door.
Long shot: The figure exits through the doorway into a thick fog.
scenes.video_prompt: Dust motes dance in the shafts of light piercing through the broken roof. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow, creeping dolly shot moves toward the figure's feet.
motion.mid: A steady tracking shot follows the figure from the side.
motion.high: A rapid whip-pan shifts from the figure to the ceiling.

scenes.still_prompt: A narrow, damp hallway lined with corroded iron pipes and leaking valves.
beats: Medium shot: The figure runs their hand along a sweating, rusted pipe.
Close-up: The figure's eyes dart frantically toward a flickering light fixture.
Wide shot: The figure stumbles through a puddle of dark oil on the floor.
Medium shot: The figure presses their back against a damp brick wall.
Close-up: The figure grips the hem of their heavy wool coat tightly.
scenes.video_prompt: Water drips rhythmically from a fractured pipe into a metal bucket. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow tilt moves from the floor to the figure's face.
motion.mid: A jittery handheld shot follows the figure's erratic movement.
motion.high: A chaotic, handheld shaky-cam moves aggressively toward the figure.

scenes.still_prompt: A vast, white salt crust landscape under a heavy, violet twilight sky.
beats: Wide shot: The figure walks a straight line toward the horizon.
Medium shot: The figure stops and looks back at their own footprints.
Close-up: The figure's boots crunch into the brittle salt crust.
Medium shot: The figure reaches out to touch the cold, stagnant water at the edge.
Long shot: The figure becomes a small silhouette against the darkening sky.
scenes.video_prompt: A cold wind ripples the surface of the shallow water. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow crane shot rises high above the figure.
motion.mid: A steady side-tracking shot matches the figure's walking pace.
motion.high: A fast zoom-in captures the figure's sudden stillness.
